contribution.position: On the reliability axis, the evidence points against shipping this week: peak memory was measured at 740MB against a 512MB budget (artifact:perf-report), a 44% overage under load that is exactly the kind of resource pressure that amplifies the retry-storm failure mode behind last quarter's two sev2 incidents (artifact:incident-log). Green tests and 87% coverage (artifact:test-report) show functional correctness but do not exercise memory headroom at peak, so the reliability case remains unresolved until the memory overage is explained or fixed.
